title: Nine Hikers Cut Their Way OUT of Their Own Tent 🏔️ Dyatlov Pass 1959 #shorts
youtube_description:
Nine experienced hikers cut their way OUT of their own tent… and walked into the freezing dark. 🏔️❄️

Dyatlov Pass, Ural Mountains, 1959. Their boots were left behind. The Soviet investigation blamed "a compelling natural force". In 2020, Russian prosecutors said it was an avalanche. Many still don't believe it.

What do you think happened on Dead Mountain? 👇

Illustrated reconstruction, no real photos. Original music.
